interface.longDescription: Free-use proprietary local Allostat: durable project memory and supported-session continuity through an isolated stdio runtime. No Allostat account, activation or hosted service. Windows x64 and CPython 3.12 required; complete bundled local-setup after marketplace installation. Existing memory and owner preferences are retained.
